def: The deep sensitive and vascular layer of the skin and mucousmembranes.-- En`de*ron"ic, a.
The act or method of weaving a cover for a ring, rope end, etc.
Made of linen; as, linen cloth; a linen stocking.
Pleasing to the taste; palatable. [Obs.] "Palative delights."Sir T. Browne.
To take by force for public service; as, to impress sailors ormoney.The second five thousand pounds impressed for the service of the sickand wounded prisoners. Evelyn.
A heavy wind; a wind that brings a storm; the blast of a storm.Longfellow.
Made of cast iron. Hence, Fig.: like cast iron; hardy;unyielding.
A house or mansion. [Sp. Amer. & Phil. Islands]
Pertaining to, or containing, announcement; making known. [R.]
A wheel turned by persons or animals, by treading, climbing, orpushing with the feet, upon its periphery or face. See Treadmill.
Any plant of the genus Arenaria, low, tufted herbs (orderCaryophyllace\'91.)
